opportunity.title: DOJ Internal Knowledge Management AI Chatbot (RAG Architecture)
opportunity.placeOfPerformance: Washington, DC (hybrid, up to 2 days on-site per week)
opportunity.description: The Department of Justice Office of Information Technology requires development of an internal knowledge management chatbot using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture. The system must ingest and index existing policy documents, legal guidance memos, and training materials stored in SharePoint and S3-compatible storage. The contractor shall build a conversational AI interface allowing DOJ staff to query the document corpus using natural language. Requirements include: FedRAMP-authorized LLM API integration, role-based access controls, audit logging of all queries and responses, and a React-based front-end deployable on DOJ's existing Azure Government environment. Deliverables: technical architecture document, working prototype at 30 days, production deployment at 90 days, and operational runbook. No past performance documentation required under the Simplified Acquisition Threshold.
